description: Shared invented cases for the suggested file name rule (DEL-07-11 REQ-009; apps/desktop/src/features/fileNames.ts qualifierSlug and fileNameOf), read by the desktop's test and by any native implementation of the same rule, which must give the same output for each case. A name is a fixed kind word, then, where the export covers a case, filter, run or state, a hyphen and a qualifier naming it, then a dot and the kind's extension. The qualifier's rule: lower case; every run of characters outside a to z and 0 to 9 becomes one hyphen; no hyphen at either end; at most 32 characters, cut at the limit and then any trailing hyphen removed; where that leaves nothing, the name has no qualifier. No name contains a project name, a project or model identifier, or a path. Every value is invented.

qualifier_cases.note: a qualifier already in the form, as it is
a run of several characters becomes one hyphen
hyphens and other characters at either end are removed
a path separator is a character outside a to z and 0 to 9, and becomes a hyphen like any other
a qualifier over 32 characters: cut at 32
a cut that lands on a hyphen: the trailing hyphen is removed, leaving 31 characters
an accented letter is outside a to z and becomes a hyphen
non-Latin letters fall away by the same rule
a qualifier with no Latin letter or digit leaves nothing
a qualifier of only punctuation leaves nothing

name_cases.note: a kind with no qualifier: the kind word and the extension
the extension is the kind's own
a qualifier follows the kind word after one hyphen
the qualifier is cut at 32 in the name too
a qualifier whose slug is empty: no qualifier and no hyphen
a qualifier of only non-Latin letters: no qualifier
